page.overview:
Who is Cruz?

Cruz was the physician at the modern Clínica Santa María hospital at Puntarenas. He had his education in the USA.

In he treated Tina Bowman's wounds and allergic reaction from her encounter with a Procompsognathus. He found the reaction very strange, therefore called his friend Martin "Marty" Guitierrez (who is a biologist from Yale working in Costa Rica) for advice.

Every morning after he spends the entire night at work, he wears a clean shirt but not a new tie. Category:Jurassic Park (novel) characters Category:Male characters Category:Living characters Category:Novel-Only Characters Category:Picture Category:Characters
